sentences.la: Utinam Lȳdia carmina sua bene disceret!
sentences.en: If only Lydia learned her songs well!
If only the fathers had worked in the city!
If only the friend had not taken the mirror!
If only Cornelius praises the friend today!

sentences.la: Utinam Iūlia carmina sua bene legeret!
sentences.en: If only Julia read her songs well!
If only Lydia had worked in the bedroom!
If only Quintus had not taken the denarii!
If only Delia praises the boy today!
If only the boys had worked in the town!
If only Lydia had not lost the dog!
If only the mothers would run home soon!
